description: Check whether the Live Tennis API is reachable and which plan the configured key is on. Useful for diagnosing why other tools are refusing data.
name: check_api_status

api_version.description: API version reported by the health check.

has_key.description: Whether a key was supplied with this call.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Identical to the text content, so either half can be used alone.

ok.description: True when the call returned data. False for a tier wall, a missing or rejected key, or an empty result — all of which are normal states with a clear remedy, not failures.

reachable.description: True when the API answered its health check.

tier.description: Detected plan: FREE, BASIC, PRO or ULTRA. Null when no key is configured.

title: API status and plan
